assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations
The patient's presentation raises concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I47.1
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with cardiac rhythm, as documented in the clinical indication note
